review_candidates.description: Network & IT SupportFirst Principles Engineer & Senior Team Member We’re hiring for our Network & IT Support team , but we’re not looking for someone whose idea of a good day is closing 20 tickets. In fact, we’d rather you prevent those 20 tickets from being created in the first place. Our team is small. Two people support close to 300 employees across Manila, Canada, and a 24-hour operation. That means we need engineers who think differently. When the same issue happens for the third time, we don't want you to become faster at fixing it. We want you to ask why it's happening at all - and eliminate it. When you see repetitive manual work, we expect you to ask whether it can be automated. When equipment, Wi-Fi, network infrastructure, endpoints, access, or security controls are likely to become problems, we want you checking them before employees discover the problem for you. When something breaks at 2 AM and you're the person on shift, we need you to be able to investigate incomplete information, form your own hypotheses, eliminate possibilities, make sound decisions, and restore operations without waiting for someone senior to tell you what to do. And when everything is working? Don't wait for the next ticket. Look at the environment and ask: What could fail next? What keeps repeating? What are we doing manually that shouldn't be manual? What can I simplify, automate, standardize, document, monitor, or permanently eliminate? That's what ownership means here. We're hiring at two levels:✨ FPE / First Principles Engineer • This is our leadership-level individual contributor. We need someone who can look beyond individual incidents and own the health and direction of the entire function - identify systemic weaknesses, prioritize improvements, design better processes and architecture, automate repetitive work, establish standards, use data to find patterns, and make the engineers around them more effective. You shouldn't need someone to continuously tell you what needs improving. You should be the person finding it. ✨ Senior Team Member - Network & IT Support We need a strong hands-on operator who can independently own a shift and keep the business running. You'll troubleshoot network, endpoint, access, infrastructure and production-impacting issues - but troubleshooting ability alone isn't enough. We need someone who sees recurring problems and closes the loop permanently . Someone who can say: "This kept happening. I investigated why. I found the root cause. I changed something. I verified it worked. And now nobody has to deal with that problem anymore." That's the standard. We're less interested in how many technologies you've touched than in how you think, what you've personally improved, and what happens to an environment after you've owned it for six months. If your instinct is to own the problem rather than escalate it, prevent rather than repeatedly repair, and improve systems rather than simply maintain them , we'd like to hear from you. We're building a small team. That means every person has to make the team disproportionately better. You won't always have a runbook. You won't always have someone to escalate to. And the problem in front of you may be something you've never encountered before. That's okay. What matters is whether you can work the problem — gather evidence, test your assumptions, change direction when the evidence tells you you're wrong, and keep going until you understand what is actually happening. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to know how to figure things out. Before you apply Please apply if you read the expectations above and can confidently say: “I've worked this way before, I've been successful doing it, and this is the level of ownership I want again.” We're not looking for someone who wants to learn how to become proactive or who believes they could operate this way given the opportunity. We're looking for people who can point to real examples where they have already owned difficult problems, worked through ambiguity, eliminated recurring issues, improved an environment, and made things better than they found them. For the FPE role, that bar is even higher. We expect evidence that you've done this beyond your own individual workload - that you've identified systemic problems, driven improvements across a function, established better ways of working, and raised the effectiveness of the people around you. So before applying, ask yourself: Have I actually done this before? Was I personally responsible for it? Can I explain what I changed and prove that it worked? And am I prepared to take that level of ownership here? If the answer is genuinely yes , we'd really like to meet you.

By providing responsive, high-quality support and continuously improving IT services, we enable teams to focus on delivering value without technical disruptions. This mid-level role is crafted for experienced IT professionals who excel in delivering high-quality technical support directly to end users across varied environments. As an IT Support Engineer, you are not only a frontline troubleshooter but also a strategic contributor to the broader support framework. You act as a critical escalation point for complex technical issues that go beyond first-line resolution, applying deep diagnostic expertise and a methodical approach to problem-solving. Your responsibilities span maintaining and enhancing the performance of end-user systems across a mixed Windows and macOS estate, managing device configurations, and leveraging AI-driven applications and workflow automation to streamline support and operational processes. In this capacity, you operate with a high degree of autonomy, often leading initiatives that improve service delivery and user satisfaction. You are expected to identify inefficiencies, implement system optimizations, and contribute to continual service improvement efforts. Collaboration is key, as you work closely with cross-functional and cross-regional teams to uphold service excellence, share best practices, and align support strategies with organizational goals. Your role also involves mentoring junior support staff, shaping technical documentation, and participating in the rollout of new technologies - including AI-driven applications and workflow automation tools - that enhance the end-user experience and operational efficiency. Ultimately, this position demands a balance of hands-on technical proficiency, strategic thinking, and a user-centric mindset. You are a trusted technical advisor within the support ecosystem, driving operational resilience and ensuring that users across the enterprise experience seamless, secure, and responsive IT services. Deliver Advanced Multi-Platform Support Provide expert-level technical assistance across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms, with depth in macOS and the wider Apple ecosystem. Act as the go-to escalation resource for macOS - covering deployment, configuration, patching, security, and advanced troubleshooting of Apple hardware and software in an enterprise environment. Ensure seamless user experiences by resolving complex device, application, and connectivity issues both onsite and remotely. Lead Troubleshooting & Escalation Management Take ownership of persistent or high-impact technical problems, applying deep diagnostic expertise. Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to escalate and resolve issues efficiently. Support & Optimize Office IT Infrastructure Maintain and enhance video conferencing systems, network connectivity, and shared office technologies. Ensure meeting spaces and collaboration tools are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with hybrid work needs. Leverage AI-Driven Applications & Workflow Automation Apply AI-driven applications and support tools - such as AI assistants, copilots, and intelligent diagnostics - to accelerate triage, troubleshooting, and resolution. Design, build, and maintain workflow automations that streamline repetitive support tasks and operational processes, reducing manual effort and improving consistency. Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation into service delivery and champion their adoption across the support team. Ensure AI tools and automated workflows are used securely and responsibly, in line with IT governance and compliance standards. Represent IT in Cross-Functional Projects Act as a technical liaison in office expansions, infrastructure upgrades, and service transitions. Provide input on planning, implementation, and post-deployment support. Maintain Documentation & Knowledge Sharing Create and refine internal documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides. Contribute to team knowledge bases and mentor peers through structured learning and informal coaching. Provide Regional Onsite Support Onsite, with occasional travel to regional offices, to deliver hands-on support, assist with deployments, and build relationships with local teams. Ensure consistent service standards across locations. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Deep, demonstrable macOS support experience in an enterprise environment — including macOS deployment, configuration, patching, security hardening, and advanced troubleshooting of Apple hardware and software. Hands-on experience managing Mac fleets with Jamf Pro, together with Apple Business Manager and the Apple Push Notification service; experience with Intune for cross-platform MDM. Advanced proficiency in Windows and mobile (iOS and Android) platforms. Hands-on experience with AI-driven applications - for example, AI assistants and copilots, chatbots, or AI-based support and diagnostic tools - to enhance productivity and service delivery. Practical experience with workflow automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate / Power Platform, ServiceNow workflows, or scripting such as PowerShell) to automate operational processes. Familiarity with ITIL service management and compliance practices. Experience supporting a global customer base and collaborating across time zones. Demonstrated professionalism, service mindset, and interpersonal skills. Proficient level of English language. Additional Information IFS is the fastest-growing international business software vendor. You will work with the leading Enterprise Software experts and have exposure to the latest technologies. You can expect an open corporate culture and a pleasant working atmosphere. Lean and effective collaboration and decision-making structures. You enjoy a high degree of personal responsibility and creative freedom in realizing your own ideas in a global environment. Attractive salary with above-average additional benefits. Car Allowance and additional compensation for business trips. Company pension plan. Further training opportunities and intensive support during the induction phase. Flexible working hours and mobile working models - Work from wherever you want, whether in the office or from home. Wellbeing-benefits: Jobrad & Wellpass 30 vacation days as well as additional special leave for birthdays and social commitment (CSR). Sounds exciting? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application through our online applicant management system in English language , stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date. We assure you explicit discretion and a comprehensive protection of your interests! We respectfully decline all offers of recruitment and/or advertising assistance.

We work as one team: we challenge ideas, align quickly, and commit together. We move with pace, without compromising on simplicity or quality. And every day, we raise the bar, strengthening our talent, pushing innovation forward, and maximizing our impact. Our Values We OWN THE OUTCOME. No silos, no excuses. We ARE CUSTOMER-FIRST. They guide our decisions. We ARE ONE TEAM. Debate, decide, commit. We MOVE WITH PACE. With simplicity and quality. We RAISE THE BAR. On talent, innovation and impact. Our employees should feel a sense of belonging, have an opportunity to grow their careers, and feel free to be their most authentic selves. Everseen takes great pride in the diversity of its global workforce, and insists upon a safe, inclusive workplace where our differences are our collective strength. Everseen is committed to creating a safe environment for all employees and has a zero tolerance policy for bias and discrimination of any kind. Our work environment is one without offensive, hostile, or intimidating conduct, whether verbal, written or physical, in nature.
